args: set -eu; dnf install -y -q tar gzip >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1 || dnf install -y -q coreutils >/dev/null 2>&1; command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; STORE_BUCKET='bucket'; STORE_ENDPOINT='http://minio.invalid:9000'; case "$OBJECT" in s3://"$STORE_BUCKET"/*) ;; *) exit 1;; esac; DATA_KEY=${OBJECT#s3://$STORE_BUCKET/}; RECEIPT_KEY=${RECEIPT#s3://$STORE_BUCKET/}; test -n "$DATA_KEY"; test -n "$RECEIPT_KEY"; NOW=$(date -u +%s); test "$NOW" -ge "$EXPIRY_EPOCH"; test "$RECEIPT" = "$OBJECT.receipt.json"; DATA_VERSION=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$DATA_KEY" --query VersionId --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"); RECEIPT_VERSION=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$RECEIPT_KEY" --query VersionId --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"); test -n "$DATA_VERSION"; test -n "$RECEIPT_VERSION"; test "$DATA_VERSION" != None; test "$RECEIPT_VERSION" != None; test "$DATA_VERSION" != null; test "$RECEIPT_VERSION" != null; test "$DATA_VERSION" = "$EXPECTED_OBJECT_VERSION"; test "$RECEIPT_VERSION" = "$EXPECTED_RECEIPT_VERSION"; ACTUAL_RECEIPT=$(aws s3api get-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$RECEIPT_KEY" --version-id "$RECEIPT_VERSION" --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT" /dev/fd/3 3>&1 1>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$ACTUAL_RECEIPT" = "$EXPECTED_RECEIPT_SHA256"; ACTUAL_OBJECT=$(aws s3api get-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$DATA_KEY" --version-id "$DATA_VERSION" --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT" /dev/fd/3 3>&1 1>/dev/null | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); test "$ACTUAL_OBJECT" = "$EXPECTED_OBJECT_SHA256"; test "$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$DATA_KEY" --query VersionId --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT")" = "$DATA_VERSION"; test "$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$RECEIPT_KEY" --query VersionId --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT")" = "$RECEIPT_VERSION"; aws s3api delete-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$DATA_KEY" --version-id "$DATA_VERSION" --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"; VISIBLE=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --prefix "$DATA_KEY" --query 'Contents[].Key' --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"); for FOUND in $VISIBLE; do test "$FOUND" != "$DATA_KEY"; done; aws s3api delete-object --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --key "$RECEIPT_KEY" --version-id "$RECEIPT_VERSION" --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"; VISIBLE=$(aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket "$STORE_BUCKET" --prefix "$RECEIPT_KEY" --query 'Contents[].Key' --output text --endpoint-url "$STORE_ENDPOINT"); for FOUND in $VISIBLE; do test "$FOUND" != "$RECEIPT_KEY"; done
